full_judgment:
3. The plaintiffs case, put in a nutshell, is that one Misrijan Banu was the original owner to the extent of 1/3rd share of land covering 6.28 acres recorded in District Settlement Khatian No. 157 and Misrijan in amicable partition had been in possession of 0.57 acres of land of Plot No. 679. Afterwards she gifted her land by Hebanama deed dated 14-3-1936 in favour of her grandsons Aminullah, Emdadullah, Basirullah and Mafizullah. Emdadullah having been owner and possessor in respect of 0.09 acres of land of Plot No. 679 transferred the said land by way of kabala deed executed and registered on 27-3-1985 in favour of plaintiff No. 1 who purchased the same in the name of Zaida Khatoon and Mofizullah also transferred his land by a kabala deed dated 6-12-1949 to Bachchu Mia. After his death, plaintiff No. 2 became his sole heir. Thereby plaintiffs became owners in possession of the suit land and record of right stands in their names. The defendant although had no title and possession in the suit land but as petitioner filed a case being No. 21 of 1990 before the Noanni Union Parishad Village Court and succeeded to obtain a judgment and order dated 6-3-1991 which is illegal and without jurisdiction. Hence the suit. 

 4. The defendant contested the suit by filing written statement denying all material allegations made in plaint contending, inter alia, that Aslam Mia, Panna Mia, Misrijan had been owners and possessors on 6.28 acres of land of khatian No. 157 and during District. Settlement operation remarks column of khatian possession was wrongly recorded. Aslam and Misrijan in amicable partition had been owners in 0.27 acres and 0.30 acres of land respectively out of 0.57 acres of land of plot No. 679 Misrijan being owner of 0.30 acres of land settled the same in favour of Zabeda Khatoon by way of Patta deed executed and registered on 19-6-1935. Misrijan transferred 1.80 acres of land by way of Heba deed dated 14-3-1936 in favour of her grandson Aminullah and others and said Misrijan did not make any Heba of any land of Plot No. 679. Thereby recipient did not acquire any title and possession of the said plot No. 679. Emdadullah did not transfer any land of plot No. 679 by way of kabala deed dated 27-3-1985 in favour of plaintiffs and did never hand over any possession in favour of plaintiffs. Mofizullah on 6-12-1949 did not transfer any land by way of kabala deed in favour of Bachchu Mia and plaintiff No. 2 also did not acquire any title and possession by way of inheritance and the said kabala deeds are forged, fraudulent and inoperative. Aslam Mia being owner and possessor of 0.27 acres of land of. plot No. 679 died leaving behind the defendant as sole heir who is exercising his right, title and possession in the suit land but the plaintiffs are creating obstructions in the works of Revisional Survey and, as such, defendant as petitioner filed the ViIIage Court Case No. 21 of 1990 and the Village Court by the judgment and order dated 6-3-1991 asked the plaintiffs to seek their redress in a competent Civil Court.
